dct_description_sm: This polygon feature is the City of Kingston Business Improvement Area (BIA) boundary. This Planning Area constitutes the core Business/Commercial area for the traditional downtown. (Provincial Municipal Act - All property/business owners within the BIA are members of the BIA Board)
